violation_type.title: No Alcohol or Controlled Substances Consumed (26 TAC §746.3703(b))
violation_type.short_title: No Alcohol or Controlled Substances Consumed
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined throughout the course of the HHS Investigation that an operational employee was under the influence of alcohol while present at the operation during operating hours and actively on the clock.

finding_variants.text: It was determined throughout the course of the HHS Investigation that an operational employee was under the influence of alcohol while present at the operation during operating hours and actively on the clock.
A caregiver brought alcohol on to the premises and was consuming it at the facility.  This was corrected when the caregiver was escorted off the premises.

The director of the operation admitted to drinking alcohol on the premises after hours in their office. Information gathered during the investigation determined that while the director was not supervising children, children were still in care during this time.

A caregiver consumed THC from a vape that was kept in the caregiver pocket.  The caregiver went in the bathroom and smoked the vape.  The caregiver returned to the classroom to care for children until the operation management staff determined a vape had been used.  The operation immediately terminated the caregiver once they confirmed the issue.
It was found that a student worker was vaping marijuana in the restroom.
It was determined through the course of the investigation that a caregiver consumed alcohol on the premises of the daycare.
